kind: targeted primary-literature comparison, not a systematic review

records.title: Towards an Algebraic Theory of Boolean Circuits
read_text: section 2.3 Theorem 3 and canonical-form proof discussion
appendix A.3 selected global-conflict and critical-peak discussion
records.established_overlap: Finite generators/relations for finite-set wiring and systematic translation of equational theories to diagrams are prior results.
not_established_here: No reproduction or formal verification of all 68 critical peaks.
No new bounded higher basis for our actual proof syntax.
No transfer of cartesian function equations to arbitrary stochastic/stateful boxes.

records.title: Graphical Methods in Device-Independent Quantum Cryptography
read_text: section 4.2 Lemmas 4.5 and 4.6, Theorem 4.7 statements and textual diagram-proof explanation
records.established_overlap: A cryptographic proof represented by higher-dimensional diagrams and partially checked in Globular predates this project. The paper describes a k=2 skeleton, not a complete machine-checked quantitative semantics.
not_established_here: No artifact execution or reconstruction of their 60-step sequence.
No quantum semantics implemented in Foundation.

records.title: String Diagrams for Monoidal Categories, in Rocq
read_text: section 5.3 normalizer correctness, restriction on empty-output nodes, and stated lack of completeness proof
section 5.4 graphical rewrite export and composing monoids
records.established_overlap: Graphical rewriting translated to textual formal proofs, structural automation, and parallel rewrite grouping already have a proof-assistant implementation.
not_established_here: The paper explicitly does not prove completeness of its mcat tactic; empty-target cases can fail.
Its general-box monoidal language and our one-sort pure-wiring completeness are different scopes. Neither is claimed to subsume the other.
No artifact build or runtime comparison performed.

records.title: UC, Categorically: Rigorous Diagrammatic Proofs
read_text: Theorem III.7 statement and textual proof
Theorems III.11 and III.12 statements, equational and diagrammatic proofs
Definition III.13 and Theorem III.14 for global resources
records.established_overlap: Rigorous diagrammatic security composition, sequential/parallel secure emulations, and composition with global resources are prior results.
not_established_here: No full reading of all Section IV translation details.
No reproduction of artifacts or claim of a proof-assistant formalization of the whole paper.
Their computational-indistinguishability framework differs from our concrete exact retained PMF laws. This difference alone does not establish novelty.
